versions.subject: refactor: rule level adjustments - critical to high
feat: multiple updates and fixes
versions.detection:
selection_reg:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
        - 'C:\users\Public\'
selection_del:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'del /s /f /q c:\'
        - '\*.bac'
        - '\*.bak'
        - '\*.bkf'
selection_net:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' stop '
        - ' /y'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'samss'
        - 'audioendpointbuilder'
        - 'unistoresvc_'
        - 'AcrSch2Svc'
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" CommandLine="*C:\\users\\Public\\*") OR (CommandLine="*del /s /f /q c:\\*" CommandLine="*\*.bac*" CommandLine="*\*.bak*" CommandLine="*\*.bkf*") OR (Image IN ("*\\net.exe", "*\\net1.exe") CommandLine="* stop *" CommandLine="* /y*" CommandLine IN ("*samss*", "*audioendpointbuilder*", "*unistoresvc_*", "*AcrSch2Svc*"))
